in_marathi.name: Grethika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Grethika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Grethika is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Gretha' meaning prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Grethika is the name of a celestial nymph who is the embodiment of wealth, prosperity, and fertility. She is often depicted as a beautiful and graceful goddess who bestows blessings of wealth, happiness, and abundance upon her devotees.
